title: rosa sicula f. ligustica
intro: Rosa sicula f. ligustica, commonly known as Italian Rosemary, is a plant species belonging to the Rosaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include relief from anxiety, insomnia, and other stress-related issues. The health benefits of Rosa sicula f. ligustica are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as its sedative and antispasmodic properties, as well as its ability to reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
